verses.pali: Abhijjhā kāyagantho, byāpādo kāyagantho, sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṁsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho—
verses.english: The personal ties to covetousness, ill will, misapprehension of precepts and observances, and the insistence that this is the only truth.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṁ ganthānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
verses.english: The noble eightfold path should be developed for the direct knowledge, complete understanding, finishing, and giving up of these four ties.”
